summary: Doc b (build d57def4280) predates the blobs R-3's tree bindings name: identity-grants-port.ts 58a45d7005 (peer WI-10002721) and control-anchor.ts 49a6b9c45c (the WI-10002717 ack guard). This drill ran the same ideate on/off transition through :3170 at f4b2626908, whose four R-3 source blobs equal canonical HEAD's. Each transition first called coord:orient {afterCompaction}, the revision-less acknowledgement that stranded drill v1 at 'desired'. Both times orient returned ok and the activation stayed pending: status desired, delivered watermark not advanced. The turn-start boundary then wrote prepared and applied. Enabling ideate produced generation 74 (desired 17260, prepared 17261, applied 17262) and disabling it produced generation 75 (17263 / 17264 / 17265). Every event carries actor == owner, principal system:superuser and adv session 29827. The gen-74 activation opened three layer spans, including ideation:su.mode-ideate, closed when gen 75 applied; gen 75 opened two without ideation. All seven drill tool calls were served by port-3170 at f4b2626908.

subject.note: The observer's own psu session. The transient ideate overlay was enabled and disabled within 37 seconds purely as a stack transition to observe; the session's AUTO mode and fleet-member posture were unchanged throughout.

sourceBlobs.basis: git rev-parse <ref>:<path> at 13:50Z; identical in f4b2626908 (the papercusp-staging checkout :3170 serves) and canonical HEAD c4ff0329e3, and clean in the working tree

replication.sql: \pset footer off \echo === q-activation (events > baseline 17259, drill window 13:45:41-13:46:19Z) SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at, e.id, e.control_generation AS gen, e.phase, e.source, e.stack_refs, left(e.specification_revision,12) AS spec, left(e.state_revision,12) AS state, e.adv_session_id AS adv, e.actor_id = e.owner_id AS actor_is_owner, e.principal_id, e.failure, e.recorded_at FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events e WHERE e.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND e.owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND e.id > 17259 AND e.recorded_at BETWEEN '2026-09-23 13:45:41+00' AND '2026-09-23 13:46:19+00' ORDER BY e.id; SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at, control_generation, control_delivered_generation, control_state->'activation'->>'status' AS status FROM harness_shared.session_briefs WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND workspace_id='papercusp-workspace'; \echo === q-spans (spans opened by the drill's applied events) SELECT count(*) AS span_count_now FROM harness_shared.session_identity_layer_spans WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd'; SELECT activation_event_id, control_generation, actor_id, principal_id, layer_slot, layer_ref, active_from, active_until FROM harness_shared.session_identity_layer_spans WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND activation_event_id IN (SELECT id FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND id > 17259 AND phase='applied' AND recorded_at BETWEEN '2026-09-23 13:45:41+00' AND '2026-09-23 13:46:19+00') ORDER BY activation_event_id, layer_slot; \echo === q-serving (tool calls served inside the drill window) SELECT id, tool_name, status, serving_host, serving_build_sha, invoked_at FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations WHERE id > 29161631 AND coord_owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND invoked_at BETWEEN '2026-09-23T13:45:41Z' AND '2026-09-23T13:46:19Z' ORDER BY id; assertions.evidence: Served by :3170 f4b2626908. mode:set ideate=on (13:45:41.4-43.6Z) wrote 17260 desired gen 74 (spec 414d45be0d46, state 61d8bb41ea8d, stack auto+fleet-member+ideate, 13:45:41.730Z). The turn-start boundary (13:45:55.0-57.4Z) then wrote 17261 prepared (56.069Z) and 17262 applied (56.129Z) with the same revision pair. mode:set ideate=off (13:46:00.4-01.6Z) wrote 17263 desired gen 75 (spec 414d45be0d46, state 16ca1bfd8aee, stack auto+fleet-member, 01.141Z); its turn-start (16.7-17.7Z) wrote 17264 prepared (16.720Z) and 17265 applied (16.750Z). session_briefs after each turn-start: 74/74 applied, then 75/75 applied.

WI-10002717 live check. Before each turn-start the drill called coord:orient {afterCompaction:true} through :3170 (13:45:43.8-54.8Z and 13:46:01.7-16.5Z). Both calls returned ok:true. The snapshots straight after them read generation/delivered/status 74/73/desired (13:45:54.996Z) and 75/74/desired (13:46:16.647Z): the delivery watermark was NOT advanced and the activation stayed pending. Drill v1 on d57def4280 showed the defect: the same call advanced the watermark and left events 16831/16832 at desired with no prepared or applied event. The prepared events here (56.069Z, 16.720Z) fall inside the turn-start calls, not the orient calls.

All six events carry actor_id == owner_id (su-38e71009...), principal_id system:superuser and adv_session_id 29827, with no failure. The five spans opened by 17262/17265 carry the same actor and principal. The transition did not re-attribute the session.

session_identity_layer_spans for the owner: activation 17262 (gen 74) opened three spans (autonomy:su.mode-auto, fleet-posture:su.fleet-member, ideation:su.mode-ideate), active 13:45:56Z-13:46:16Z. Activation 17265 (gen 75) opened two (autonomy, fleet-posture) from 13:46:16Z, still open at read time, with no ideation span. So the ideation layer is attributable to exactly the 20-second window its activation was applied.

tool_invocations for the owner in 13:45:41-13:46:19Z: all seven drill calls (mode:set x2, coord:orient x2, state:read x2, work_items:get) carry serving_host port-3170 and serving_build_sha f4b2626908, as do the reads coord:orient fans out to (coord:catch-up, coord:glance, coord:inbox, coord:plan-events, coord:whoami, fleet:assignments, plans:get, work_items:list, work_items:observe, two each). The :3070 rows in the window are the observer session's own concurrent calls (activity:report x2, coord:glance x2, tools:invoke -> work_items:checkpoint); none is a mode or activation write.

The :3170 turn-start-memory responses carried both payloads: 12 (after ideate on) a ⟦stack⟧ attach op for slot ideation / su.mode-ideate plus a ⟦CTRL:transition⟧ block with modes [auto, ideate]; 17 (after ideate off) a ⟦stack⟧ detach op for the same slot plus a CTRL block with modes [auto].

notProven: A REAL hook-originated boundary. The turn-start POST was issued by the drill script with the hook's body shape so the call hit :3170. The installed hook targets :3070.
